articles.headline: Apple reports higher earnings and revenue
articles.articleSummary: Apple reported revenue growth and higher quarterly profits. Management raised its full-year earnings guidance.

articles.headline: Company reports lower profit as costs rise
articles.articleSummary: Quarterly profit declined and revenue missed expectations. Management lowered its outlook.

articles.headline: Company announces annual shareholder meeting
articles.articleSummary: The company scheduled its annual shareholder meeting for next month. Shareholders will vote on routine board appointments.
